learningObjectives: Apply grouping and aggregation operations to datasets.
Combine multiple datasets using merge and join operations.
Transform tabular data for analytical workflows.

activities.title: Explore GroupBy
activities.instruction: Build a GroupBy operation to summarize data by category.

content.concept: GroupBy divides a DataFrame into groups based on one or more columns so that calculations can be performed on each group.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Match Aggregations
activities.instruction: Identify what each aggregation tells you about grouped data.

content.concept: Aggregation functions summarize grouped values using measures such as sum, mean, count, minimum, and maximum.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Join the Datasets
activities.instruction: Explore how related tables can be combined using a common key.

content.concept: Pandas merge and join operations combine related datasets using matching columns or indexes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The first dataset participating in the combination.
The second dataset containing related information.
A column whose matching values connect records between datasets.
The operation that combines rows from the related datasets.
The resulting DataFrame containing the combined information.

activities.title: Transform the Data
activities.instruction: Arrange the transformation steps into a logical analytical workflow.

content.concept: Data transformation can involve selecting, filtering, deriving, grouping, reshaping, and aggregating information for analysis.
